programs.name: W.E. Build
programs.short: Twelve-week, full-time, in-person accelerator for women founders who are already in market and ready to scale.

decider.v: a selection committee of staff and community members

checks.text: Is in, or has finished, another accelerator (ACT Tulsa, BiT Techstars, Lightship)
checks.note: The handbook calls this the knock-out question. The screening rubric also scores "at most 1 prior accelerator", so which is it?

checks.text: Lives in Tulsa or will relocate for the program
checks.note: Scored in screening, not a hard no.

checks.text: Company is incorporated (LLC, S-Corp or C-Corp)
Can commit 40 hours a week in person, Sept 1 to Nov 20

steps.name: Application screening
criteria: Company age (founded less than 5 years ago)
Number of paying clients, users or contracts
Stage and product-market fit (in market, emerging or strong PMF)
steps.note: Nov 19: one person files the review for a stage. The older pages showed 3 screeners.

steps.name: Second round interview
steps.note: Same rubric as round one. Panel of 4 internal and 3 to 5 community members.

after.text: Conditional offer
Reference check (a short questionnaire to referees)
Background check
Agreements signed, then orientation

questions.q: Are the second interview and the committee decision really one step?
questions.why: If yes, W.E. Build runs on three steps instead of four.

questions.q: Do you screen applications as they come in, or all together after the deadline? Who assigns reviewers?
Which answers on the form are an automatic no?
After the committee says yes, what is the order: offer, reference check, background check, orientation? Does anything wait on the background check?
Do community reviewers enter their reviews in Salesforce?

programs.name: BUILD UP
programs.short: Four-week pre-accelerator for early founders, with a Tech track and a CPG (consumer product) track.

form.v: BUILD UP Application 2026 (one form for both tracks)
form.note: Three different application links are live on the website.

first.v: an optional info session on Eventbrite

deadline.v: Feb 22 or Mar 1, 2026 (both are on the site)

size.v: up to 35 Tech and at least 15 CPG founders

decider.v: the program coordinator and program manager, in a weekly meeting

checks.text: Based in Tulsa or committed to building here
Picks a track: Tech or CPG
Is early-stage
Willing to do customer interviews, assignments and coaching

steps.name: Eligibility check
steps.note: The coordinator checks location, track and stage in the Google Sheet.

steps.name: Interview
steps.note: On Zoom, booked through Calendly. The coordinator or manager fills in the intake summary and gives a recommendation.

after.text: Welcome email and onboarding forms (onboarding, marketing release, knowledge check)
To complete: 4 workshops, at least 1 coaching session and a finished data room
$100 completion payment

questions.q: Is BUILD UP one program with two tracks, or two separate programs?
questions.why: This decides how it is set up and reported.

questions.q: Which application link is the live one, and which close date is right: Feb 22 or Mar 1?
Are CPG applicants decided in the same weekly meeting as Tech?
Does every eligible applicant get an interview?
How are the interview ratings scored? 1 to 4, like W.E. Build?

programs.name: Female Founders Pitch Night
programs.short: Six-week cohort for female-identifying founders with a tech product, ending in a live Pitch Night with cash prizes.

rhythm.v: once a year (it has run up to three times a year before)

decider.v: a screening committee of staff and panelists

checks.text: Startup is based in Tulsa
checks.note: The website says Tulsa. Confluence says Tulsa or Oklahoma.

checks.text: Product is tech or tech-enabled
Already has an MVP
Company is under 5 years old
Is in a prohibited industry
checks.note: No list of industries is written down.

checks.text: Applied before with the same company
Is currently in an accelerator (ACT Tulsa, W.E. Build, Lightship)

steps.name: Eligibility check
steps.note: Checks location, prior participation and industry. A no reads "did not meet criteria".

steps.name: Application scoring
criteria: Need for the Female Founders Pitch Night workshops
steps.note: Staff and/or panelists score in Google Sheets or the 2026 Airtable base.

steps.name: Interview
steps.note: Booked on Calendly, held on Zoom. Panelists fill in scorecards and a recommendation for the cohort. No-shows are recorded.

steps.name: Final selection
steps.note: "Scores are aggregated for final selection." Is this a meeting, or does the top score win a place?

after.text: Onboarding and marketing forms, then orientation
Workshops (six or seven; the sources differ), weekly coaching and pitch practices
Only founders who complete the full program can pitch
Pitch Night: judges hear a 5-minute pitch and 3 minutes of Q&A. Prizes $10,000, $5,000, $2,500 and $1,000 Audience Choice; $100 to everyone else
W-9 collected so prizes and stipends can be paid

questions.q: Who sits on the screening committee, and is there a cut-off score?
When are interviews held now that the deadline moved to March 27?
questions.why: The website still lists March 9 to 13.

questions.q: Is eligibility Tulsa-based, or anywhere in Oklahoma?
What does "complete the full program" mean, so a founder can pitch?
Which is the record: Typeform, the FFPN Airtable base, or Google Sheets?

programs.name: Product Pitch Night
programs.short: Eight-week training for founders building physical products, ending in a Pitch Night with cash prizes. 2026 is the fourth cohort.

deadline.v: August 21, 2026, with founders picked by September 11

checks.text: Startup in Tulsa or the surrounding Oklahoma area, and founder lives in Oklahoma
Has a functioning MVP
Physical product, not software alone
checks.note: The form still offers "Software" as a product category.

checks.text: Team of up to three founders
Cannabis, tobacco, alcohol or adult entertainment, or a registered nonprofit
Works for TCF or GKFF, or is family of someone who does
Is or was in ACT House, BiT Techstars, Lightship or W.E. Build

steps.name: Screening committee interview
criteria: Need for the Product Pitch Night workshops
steps.note: Each committee record has interview notes, an interview summary and a final score.

after.text: One-on-one coaching and workshops (Sept 22 to Oct 15)
Four hours of in-person pitch practice and a dress rehearsal
Introductions to Tulsa and Oklahoma manufacturing partners
Pitch Night prizes: $10,000, $5,000, $2,500 and $1,000 Audience Choice

questions.q: Does the committee score the written application before the interview, or only after it?
Who sits on the screening committee?
Is software-only eligible?
questions.why: The website says no; the form lists Software as a category.

questions.q: Does a "yes" to "are you in an accelerator?" rule someone out?
Must founders complete the program to pitch?

programs.name: 1921 Award
programs.short: Award honoring eight Tulsans who carry the spirit of Black Wall Street. People nominate themselves or someone else.

entry.v: being nominated, by themselves or someone else

decider.v: a committee of BiT team members and Tulsa community leaders

checks.text: Born in Tulsa, or has lived here 10+ years
checks.note: The form asks "half their life"; the website says 10+ years.

checks.text: Nominee is 18 or older
Runs a for-profit business that has operated 3+ years, with a legal structure
Past participant of W.E. Build, BiT Techstars or ACT House, or a pitch-night winner
Cannabis, adult industry or nonprofit; or works for TCF/GKFF or is family of someone who does
Eligible to work in the U.S.
checks.note: Published, but the form does not ask it.

steps.name: Eligibility check
steps.note: Nobody is named as checking nominees against past BiT programs.

steps.name: Selection committee
criteria: Embodies the resilient, innovative spirit of Black Wall Street
steps.note: The three criteria are published. Whether they are scored is not, and no scores are kept today.

after.text: Awardees notified
Award ceremony (late May or early June); attendance is required
Permission to share the awardee's story, photos and testimonials

questions.q: Are nominees interviewed, or chosen from the nomination alone?
Are the three criteria scored? If so, where do the scores go?
Who checks a nominee against past BiT programs?
Is it always eight awardees?
Do you collect permission to publicize awardees and testimonials?

rhythm.v: monthly, on a rolling basis (five dates are published for 2026)

deadline.v: the 3rd Friday of the month before the market

checks.text: Is a licensed business in Tulsa
checks.note: The form asks; nothing says what a "no" does.

checks.text: December Holiday Market is invite-only

steps.name: Vendor selection
steps.note: "Businesses are selected each month on a rolling basis." Nothing else is written down.

after.text: Vendor confirmed for a market date
Sets up and sells, 6 to 9 PM at BiT HQ

questions.q: Who picks vendors each month, and what do they look for?

Do vendors apply again every month?
